# PriceYou

> PriceYou tracks prices for luxury watches, jewelry, and bags. Users follow their favorite brands, keep a private portfolio of what they own, and a watchlist of what they want, with price-change alerts.

PriceYou is operated by NORELIX LIMITED (Dublin, Ireland). It is not a marketplace and does not provide investment advice — values shown are estimates for personal tracking.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, features, pricing, and FAQ.
- [Quiz](/quiz): Short onboarding to seed the initial watchlist.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the PriceYou team.
- [Blog](/blog): Guides and market notes on luxury watches, jewelry, and bags.
- [Billing overview](/billing): Plan details and billing information.
